sections.title: Advanced Concept
sections.content: Level 3 includes multiple transactions, compound profit/loss, partner profit sharing, and inverse ratio profit sharing. Profit occurs when SP > CP, Loss when SP < CP. Example: An item costing ₹100 is first sold at 10% profit, then at 5% loss.

sections.title: Multi-item and Partner Examples in ₹
sections.content: A trader buys and sells multiple items. Partner profit sharing includes ratios. Example: Item1: CP ₹200, SP ₹250; Item2: CP ₹150, SP ₹120; Partners ratio 2:3 → calculate individual profit shares.

sections.title: Successive and Compound Profit/Loss %
sections.content:
Successive Profit % = [(1 + p1/100)(1 + p2/100) - 1] × 100
Successive Loss % = [1 - (1 - l1/100)(1 - l2/100)] × 100
Compound profit/loss = multi-step transactions using SP and CP multiplication/division.

sections.title: Important Formulas
sections.content:
1. SP = CP + Profit
2. SP = CP - Loss
3. Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100
4. Loss% = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100
5. Successive Profit% = [(1+p1/100)(1+p2/100)...-1]×100
6. Successive Loss% = [1-(1-l1/100)(1-l2/100)...]×100
7. Partner Profit = Total Profit × (Individual Ratio ÷ Total Ratio)

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content: Adding successive/compound percentages directly, forgetting partner ratio, incorrect multi-item CP/SP calculation.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Level 3 includes multi-item, successive/compound profit/loss, partner ratios, inverse ratio calculations. SP > CP → Profit, SP < CP → Loss.

tricks.title: Successive Profit/Loss shortcut
tricks.explanation: Do not add successive % directly. Use formula: (1+p1/100)(1+p2/100)-1.

tricks.title: Compound Profit/Loss quick trick
tricks.explanation: For multiple transactions, calculate SP and CP stepwise, then total %.
tricks.example: CP ₹100, SP ₹120, next SP ₹120 → total profit% ≈ 44%

tricks.title: Partner Profit ratio trick
tricks.explanation: Profit share = Total Profit × (Individual Ratio ÷ Total Ratio)

tricks.title: Inverse ratio profit sharing
tricks.explanation: Loss/profit inversely proportional to CP contribution.

tricks.title: Multi-item Profit/Loss quick check
tricks.explanation: Calculate CP/SP for each item separately, then sum to find net result.
tricks.example: Item1: CP ₹100 SP ₹120; Item2: CP ₹150 SP ₹140 → Net Profit = ₹10

tricks.title: Discount + Profit/Loss shortcut
tricks.explanation: SP = Marked Price - Discount, then calculate Profit/Loss %.

tricks.title: Quick SP vs CP check
tricks.explanation: SP - CP >0 → Profit, SP - CP <0 → Loss

tricks.title: Multi-step transaction mental trick
tricks.explanation: Stepwise CP/SP for each item, sum, then calculate net %.
tricks.example: Item1 CP ₹50 SP ₹60; Item2 CP ₹80 SP ₹75 → Net Loss = 5

tricks.title: Partner + Compound trick
tricks.explanation: Apply partner ratio on compound transactions for exact profit/loss.
